subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: Netflix: From DVDs to Your Phone
description: Learn Netflix: From DVDs to Your Phone in one minute.

hook.text: Netflix mailed red envelopes with DVDs. Then it destroyed its own business model.

buildup.text: Netflix launched streaming in 2007 and went mobile in 2010, bringing movies everywhere.

discovery.text: Original content like House of Cards proved streaming platforms could rival Hollywood studios.

twist.text: Netflix killed Blockbuster, which at its peak had 9,000 stores and 65 million members.

climax.text: Netflix proved that convenience beats tradition. People chose streaming over movie theaters.

punchline.text: Red envelopes became a streaming empire.

quiz.question: What retailer did Netflix famously drive to bankruptcy?
